change: Separate Porsche body/load properties from pickup: DIN baseline mass, exported axle datums and track widths, rear-wheel-drive force distribution, published drag area, estimated rearward CG and yaw inertia. Integrate CG velocity and recover authored model-origin motion; use active mass in translational vehicle/debris impulses.

scope: Vertical-force conservation and positive loads across acceleration grids
Unsaturated roll and pitch moment balance at different normal loads
RWD drive goes to rear while passive braking/rolling forces retain axle shares
CG/origin velocity inverse and fixed-CG rotation transport

limits: Finite motion and basic driving smoke test, not complete vehicle clearance or OEM physics
Zero-pose linkages are compared against the existing production rig; live wing actuators intentionally adjust their raw authoring rest frames
Source-fitted suspension, live screens and planar scene mirrors are implemented; Porsche tire-force tuning, optical appearance, instrument artwork and material refinements remain in development
DIN mass is used as a game baseline; occupant, payload and fuel-mass variation are not modeled
CG height, static distribution, roll split and inertia are provisional, not measured 992 GT3 RS calibration
Existing simplified engine acceleration/RPM, gearbox behavior, speed limit, tire curve, suspension rates and aero/downforce still need development
Collision update changes translational mass weighting; contact-point rotational collision impulses are not implemented
No verified OEM acceleration, stopping distance, cornering envelope, lap time or final visual fidelity claim
